_comment: Hand-maintained values for annual sources. Update when the source publishes; reviewBy says when to check again.

counters.label: Doomsday Clock
counters.trendLabel: 4 s closer than 2025 (89 s); closest ever
counters.note: A symbolic setting by the Bulletin's Science and Security Board, not a measurement or a probability.

counters.label: Nuclear warheads
counters.trendLabel: 9,745 military stockpile · 4,012 deployed. Was 12,241 a year earlier
counters.note: New START expired in February 2026 with no replacement. Inventory is shrinking only because retired warheads are being dismantled; usable stockpiles are growing.

counters.label: Earth Overshoot Day
counters.trendLabel: Humanity used a year of renewable resources by this date
counters.note: Modelled estimate by Global Footprint Network and York University.
